dataset: FuelEconomy.gov (U.S. DOE/EPA) bulk vehicle feed, all model years
rule: A body derivative year is published for every EPA model year with a configuration whose make and model name exactly equal one of the reviewed epaModels; years outside the regular EPA window come only from these mappings. epaModels are mapped only where the EPA model name carries the manufacturer's estate body designation (Wagon, Sport Wagon, SportCombi, Sport Brake) for that nameplate. Names that mix bodies are not mapped: Subaru 'Impreza Wagon' also labels later 5-door hatchbacks and 'Legacy/Outback Wagon' combines the Outback. Absence of a mapped name in a year is not evidence that the body was not sold.
